back_squat: standing upright in a squat rack with a loaded olympic barbell resting on the upper back, feet shoulder-width, side view
performs one slow controlled barbell back squat: descends until thighs are parallel to the floor, then drives back up to standing
leg_press: seated in a 45-degree leg press machine with feet on the platform, legs extended (knees soft), side view
performs one controlled leg press rep: lowers the platform bending the knees to 90 degrees, then pushes it back up
rdl: standing tall holding a loaded barbell at the hips with straight arms, side view
performs one romanian deadlift: hinges at the hips with a flat back, slides the bar down the thighs to mid-shin, then squeezes glutes back to standing
deadlift: standing tall holding a loaded barbell after a completed deadlift lockout, side view
lowers the barbell to the floor with a flat back by hinging hips and bending knees, briefly touches the floor, then lifts it back up to full lockout
db_lunge: standing upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, side view
performs one forward lunge: steps forward, lowers until the back knee nearly touches the floor, then pushes back to standing
bulgarian_split: standing in a split stance with the rear foot elevated on a flat bench, holding dumbbells at the sides, side view
performs one bulgarian split squat: lowers straight down until the front thigh is parallel, then drives back up
leg_ext: seated in a leg extension machine, knees bent at 90 degrees, hands on the handles, side view
extends both knees lifting the pad until legs are straight, squeezes, then slowly lowers back down
leg_curl: lying face down on a lying leg curl machine with the pad behind the ankles, legs straight, side view
curls the heels toward the glutes, squeezes the hamstrings, then slowly lowers back to straight legs
calf_raise: standing on a step platform in a standing calf raise machine, heels slightly lowered, side view
rises up high onto the toes, pauses at the top, then slowly lowers the heels below the platform
hip_thrust: sitting on the floor with upper back against a flat bench, padded barbell across the hips, knees bent, side view
drives the hips up until the torso is parallel to the floor, squeezes the glutes, then lowers back down
pullup: hanging from a high pull-up bar mounted well above head height, with an overhand grip, arms fully extended, feet clearly off the ground with knees slightly bent and ankles crossed, front three-quarter view
performs one strict pull-up: pulls until the chin clears the bar, then lowers slowly to a full hang
lat_pulldown: seated at a lat pulldown machine holding a wide bar overhead with straight arms, front three-quarter view
pulls the bar down to the upper chest squeezing the shoulder blades, then lets it rise slowly back up
cable_row: seated at a low cable row machine, feet on the platform, holding a V-handle with arms extended, side view
rows the handle to the stomach pulling the elbows back and squeezing the back, then extends the arms slowly
bb_row: hinged forward about 45 degrees with a flat back, holding a loaded barbell with straight arms below the knees, side view
rows the barbell to the lower chest, squeezes the shoulder blades, then lowers it with control
db_row: one knee and one hand on a flat bench, back flat, holding a dumbbell in the other hand with the arm extended, side view
rows the dumbbell up to the hip keeping the elbow close, then lowers it slowly
face_pull: standing facing a high cable pulley holding a rope attachment with arms extended at face height, side view
pulls the rope toward the face splitting the ends apart with elbows high, then returns slowly
bench_press: lying on a flat bench under a loaded barbell, arms locked out holding the bar above the chest, side view
lowers the barbell slowly to the mid chest, then presses it back up to full lockout
incline_db_press: lying on an incline bench holding two dumbbells pressed above the upper chest, side view
lowers the dumbbells to chest level with elbows at 45 degrees, then presses them back up
cable_fly: standing in the middle of a cable crossover station, one foot forward, holding handles with arms open wide at chest height, front view
brings the hands together in a wide hugging arc in front of the chest, squeezes, then opens slowly
pushup: in a high plank push-up position on the gym floor, arms straight, body in a straight line, side view
lowers the chest close to the floor keeping the body rigid, then pushes back up
dips: supported on parallel dip bars with arms locked out, legs slightly bent, side view
does one controlled parallel-bar exercise: bends the elbows to lower the body a little, then straightens the arms back up, athletic gym training
ohp: standing holding a loaded barbell at the front of the shoulders, side view
presses the barbell straight overhead to lockout, then lowers it back to the shoulders
lateral_raise: standing holding light dumbbells at the sides, front view
raises both arms out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lowers slowly
rear_delt_fly: seated facing the pad of a reverse pec-deck machine, arms extended forward holding the handles, side three-quarter view
opens the arms back in a wide arc squeezing the rear shoulders, then returns slowly
bb_curl: standing holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms extended at the thighs, side view
curls the bar up to the shoulders keeping elbows pinned, then lowers slowly
hammer_curl: standing holding dumbbells at the sides with palms facing in, front three-quarter view
curls both dumbbells up with a neutral grip, then lowers slowly
rope_pushdown: standing facing a high cable pulley holding a rope attachment, elbows bent at 90 degrees at the sides, side view
pushes the rope down until the arms are straight, spreading the ends apart, then returns slowly
oh_tri_ext: seated on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands straight overhead, side view
lowers the dumbbell behind the head by bending the elbows, then extends back up
plank: holding a forearm plank on a gym mat, body in a perfectly straight line, side view
holds the forearm plank steadily, breathing, with tiny core-bracing adjustments
hanging_leg_raise: hanging from a high pull-up bar mounted well above head height, arms straight, feet clearly off the ground, legs straight, side view
raises the straight legs up to hip height in a controlled manner, then lowers slowly without swinging
woodchop: standing sideways to a high cable pulley holding the handle with both hands above one shoulder, front view
pulls the handle diagonally down across the body to the opposite hip rotating the torso, then returns
ab_wheel: kneeling on a mat holding an ab wheel on the floor under the shoulders, side view
rolls the wheel forward extending the body while bracing the core, then rolls back to the start
kb_swing: standing with feet wide holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of the hips, side view
performs one kettlebell swing: hinges and hikes the bell back, then snaps the hips to swing it to chest height, and lets it swing back
burpee: standing upright on the gym floor, side view
performs one burpee: squats down, jumps feet back to a plank, does a push-up, jumps feet forward and explodes into a jump with arms overhead
farmer_carry: standing tall holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides, front three-quarter view
walks forward with heavy dumbbells, tall posture, braced core, steady steps
box_jump: standing in front of a plyometric box, side view
swings the arms and jumps explosively onto the box, lands softly in a squat, then steps back down
battle_rope: standing in an athletic half squat holding the ends of two thick battle ropes, front three-quarter view
creates fast powerful alternating waves with the battle ropes
rower: seated on an indoor rowing machine at the catch position, knees bent, arms extended, side view
performs one rowing stroke: drives with the legs, leans back slightly, pulls the handle to the ribs, then returns to the catch
sled_push: leaning into a loaded push sled, hands on the vertical poles, on gym turf, side view
drives the heavy sled forward with powerful steps, low body angle
treadmill_run: running on a modern treadmill, mid-stride, side view
runs at a steady fast pace on the treadmill with good running form
jumping_jacks: standing upright with arms at the sides, feet together, side three-quarter view
performs one jumping jack: jumps feet wide while raising arms overhead, then jumps back to feet together with arms down
arm_circles: standing tall with both arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height, front view
makes controlled big circles with both straight arms, a shoulder warm-up
leg_swings: standing on one leg holding a squat rack upright with one hand for balance, side view
swings the free straight leg forward and backward in a controlled dynamic hip warm-up
inchworm: standing tall with feet together, side view

slowly bends forward and places both hands on the floor in front of the feet, walks the hands forward step by step into a push-up plank, then walks the hands back to the feet and slowly stands up. Feet stay on the floor the whole time, no jumping, no flips
bw_squat: standing with feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed, side view
does one slow air squat as a warm-up drill, sitting the hips back and down with arms forward, then rising back to standing, fitness training
high_knees: standing tall in a gym in an athletic ready position, arms bent at 90 degrees, front three-quarter view, fully clothed in the black t-shirt and black shorts
jogs lightly in place with high knee lifts and arm swings as a cardio warm-up in the gym
quad_stretch: standing on one leg holding the other ankle behind the glutes, knees together, one hand on a rack for balance, side view
holds a standing quadriceps stretch calmly, breathing slowly, small natural movements
hamstring_stretch: sitting on a gym mat with one leg straight forward and the other bent, reaching toward the toes of the straight leg, side view
holds a seated hamstring stretch calmly, breathing slowly and reaching slightly further
hip_flexor_stretch: kneeling on one knee on a gym mat in a low lunge: right foot forward with the front knee bent 90 degrees, left knee resting on the mat behind, torso upright, hands on the front knee, side view
holds a kneeling hip flexor stretch calmly, gently pressing the hips forward while breathing
chest_stretch: standing beside a squat rack upright, one forearm placed flat against the upright at shoulder height, side view
holds a chest stretch by gently rotating the torso away from the arm, breathing slowly
shoulder_stretch: standing tall pulling one straight arm across the chest with the other arm, front three-quarter view
holds a cross-body shoulder stretch calmly, breathing slowly
child_pose: kneeling on a gym mat sitting back on the heels, torso folded forward, arms stretched forward on the mat, side view
holds the child's pose stretch, breathing slowly and deeply, back relaxing
air_squat: standing upright on the gym floor with feet shoulder-width apart and both arms extended straight forward at shoulder height, no equipment, side view
performs one slow controlled bodyweight squat: descends until the thighs are parallel to the floor keeping the heels down and the arms forward, then stands back up
bw_lunge: standing upright on the gym floor in strict side profile view (seen from the side, facing right), feet together, hands on the hips, no equipment

performs one forward lunge seen from the side: takes a long step forward with one leg, lowers until the back knee nearly touches the floor with the front knee bent 90 degrees, then pushes back to standing with feet together
glute_bridge: lying on the back on a gym mat with knees bent, feet flat on the floor and arms resting on the floor at the sides, no equipment, side view

mountain_climber: in a high plank position on the gym floor, arms straight, body in a straight line, no equipment, side view
